ns2:course.label: Voice
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 381) Instruction in voice at the advanced undergraduate and graduate level. 2 or 3 undergraduate hours, or 2 or 4 graduate hours (Summer session, 1 or 2 undergraduate or graduate hours.) Prerequisite: For students in the Bachelor of Music program. Primarily for music majors; junior standing. Passing of an audition is required prior to initial registration in any applied music course as approved by the faculty of the appropriate applied music division.
